scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The proof is explicit; no finite experiment, external certificate, or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: No classification of continuity points and no claim for uncountable signatures.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proved: The join map is a pointwise limit of continuous finite-premise approximants and is discontinuous for the one-unary-function signature.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Countable algebraic signatures under ordinary finitary equational logic.
